scope: 50ms approximate /proc snapshots of parent Python process native workers. wchan cannot identify pin/FIFO/idle futex ownership, snapshots not atomic. Includes startup, workload, recovery and verification; no per-phase classification. Observer overhead unmeasured.
decision: No worker-cap change admitted. Futex observations cannot separate idle queue from snapshot/FIFO waits, nor prove CPU starvation. Add explicit lifecycle-scoped worker-state observation before pre-worker admission design.50ms sleep is not50ms sampling cadence: per-thread reads and scheduling add time. Runtime sources unchanged.
